details.name: Rossi
details.quote: I'm Rossina, granted name Wulfperl, meaning the Pack's treasure! You'd better remember that! Ah ... Endmin, you can call me whatever you prefer...
details.infection: Oripathy positive (infected), based on medical examination reports.
details.exp1d: Situational Analysis: Clan Diplomat Being able to sniff out a scam is a dangerous talent for a child.
details.exp2d: Street Wisdom: Conflict Mediator Rossi is tired of endless bickering. So, she mastered the means of getting both sides to shut up.
details.hb1d: Nature: Fantasies for Heroism A weird-looking stone and a sharp chisel have been selected. Now, who should this figurine look like?
details.hb2d: Sports: Game of the Hunt Tracking down a prey is a long process, but Rossi is very patient. No need to rush, for we are close to the scent of blood.
details.matskill: Lupine Scarlet, Rapid Ascent, Glorious Memory
